doc.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

title: Opinion on rap
summary: Pallo says he cannot connect with rap and would not be called for it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Which I assume isn’t on your radio.
I can’t associate with it. I just can’t. To me it’s poetry. But the music is a drum beat and a little bit —

And bass heavy. So I don’t pay too much attention to it. It’s probably good, I can’t put it all down because the kids love it, but it’s not my thing so if I ever received a call for something like that I would never do it, which I wouldn’t though, they wouldn’t call me.
Well I don’t think they use too much guitar anyway.
No. In some cases they do. Very few.
